Introduction: Kozminski Community Academy is located on the south side of Chicago (5400 South, 900 East) in the racially and economically diverse Hyde Park community. The school is located in a park setting with the University of Chicago and the Museum of Science and Industry nearby. Kozminski serves approximately 255 students from Pre-Kindergarten through the 8th grade. The school is an Options for Knowledge school with 30% of its students bused. The student population is 99.8% African-American. Over 90% of our students are low-income with receiving free or reduced lunch. The school has an attendance rate of 95%. Our mission is to challenge our students with a highly structured, standards-based curriculum that incorporates the Common Core State Standards through use of literacy and writing, math, science, technology integration, parental involvement, professional development, and collaboration of stakeholders.

Introduction:
<Welcome to Mary Lyon School!

At Mary Lyon, we are dedicated to nurturing the whole child and preparing each student for college, future career paths, and the challenges of the 21st century. As a collaborative school community, we work together to inspire and motivate our students to reach their full potential. Our goal is to provide opportunities for students to explore subjects that ignite their curiosity, develop advanced research and communication skills, and unlock their creative, problem-solving, and analytical potential—all while fostering teamwork, collaboration, and a joyful daily learning experience.

The faculty and staff at Mary Lyon are committed to delivering rigorous, grade-level instruction every day. We aim to build our students’ confidence, enhance their social-emotional skills, and equip them with essential time management and study techniques to ensure they are well-prepared for college and career success.

Mary Lyon School is proud to be part of CPS Network 3 and to serve the vibrant Belmont Cragin community. Together, we strive to create an environment where every student can thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. This year, we are especially excited to celebrate 100 years of educating Chicago’s children in the Belmont Cragin community. Join us as we honor this milestone and continue building a bright future for our Mary Lyon Lions!

Introduction:
Pilsen is a community where students come first and all voices are heard and valued. At Pilsen, we believe that all students have the capacity for growth and the potential to create positive change in our society. With consistent communication, collaboration and reflection, Pilsen staff will continue to improve our ability to support all students. Through this work and by building strong family and community partnerships, students will develop the independence, perseverance, and compassion for themselves and others necessary for future success.

PCA is proud to offer its students a technology rich environment with Promethean Boards, iPads, and Chromebooks in each classroom. Our low teacher to student ratio allows for small group and individualized learning to take place throughout every day.

Introduction:
We are the Wolfpack!

Kellogg is a small by design school with an CPS recognized Exemplary IB Middle Years Programme and Personalized Learning located in North Beverly. Kellogg is the home of the Wolfpack and serves neighborhood students in kindergarten through eighth grade.

We are proud to be a neighborhood school recognized as an ISBE Exemplary School (top 10% of schools statewide) in 2023 and as an Established Supportive School by CPS. Kellogg was also recognized by Chicago Magazine as a Top 25 Chicago Elementary School.

We have a Northwestern University FUSE STEM Design Studio that features two 3D printers and Project Lead the Way Robotics and Automation.

Kellogg is 1:1 with Chromebooks and also has a Smartboard in each classroom.

Kellogg is the only CPS school to earn 4 Chicago Excellence in Gardening Awards. We have a chicken coop, two bee hives through the Whole Kids Foundation, an eat what you grow Learning Garden, and a $10,000 Illinois Clean Energy funded Pollinator Garden.

Partnerships include a United Voices Chicago Choir, Might Acorns Science, Big Green, Peace Club, Chicago Chess Foundation, Project Lead the Way, Entrepreneurship Class, and Restorative Justice class for 7th grader students.

If you live outside our attendance boundaries, you are welcome to apply through Go CPS to be placed on our wait list. 

In partership,

Cory Overstreet, EdD

Principal

Introduction:
Jungman STEM Magnet is a vibrant and welcoming school community where students grow into confident, curious, and capable global citizens. We focus on helping every child develop strong skills in leadership, creativity, communication, collaboration, and critical thinking.

Our state-of-the-art STEM Lab includes a Broadcast Studio, 3D printers, HP Sprout all-in-one systems, a Carvey machine, and Creative Learning Systems software—giving students hands-on experiences that bring STEM learning to life.

We are also a 1:1 technology school, which means every student has access to their own device each day.

Jungman offers rich after-school opportunities in both the arts and academics, as well as a variety of enrichment programs. Families also have the option to enroll in our convenient school-based after-school care program.

Families applying through GoCPS may be eligible for transportation, depending on where they live. Students who reside between 1.5 and 6 miles from the school qualify for bussing services.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Jungman Eagles community!

Introduction:
Dixon Elementary School houses pre-kindergarten through eighth grades with a total population of 500 students, with 99% of the students being African American.  The school has a functioning Dell computer lab, Chrome book carts for all classrooms (1 to 1), a science lab, and a learning resource center.  These labs are in place because Dixon is a mathematics and science magnet cluster school with an emphasis on fine arts, literacy, and technology.

Students at Dixon also have other interests, talents, and needs in addition to major subjects studied at school.  Participation in extracurricular activities enhances natural abilities, broadens knowledge and interests, and provides opportunities to excel in other arenas.  This is why we have various activities that range from boys' and girls' sports to a drama club, a greenhouse where students grow different vegetables and flowers, sewing, and even a program on how to become a veterinarian.

Dixon stresses culture to its students. The school has been recognized as an exhibit due to the many African sculptures, artifacts, and paintings that are exhibited throughout the building.  The three floors have themes based on the artifacts and portraits on the wall.  We also host an annual African American bazaar Cultural Connections, which is held the second weekend in March.  This bazaar host vendors from around the country, where they are able to showcase their African artifacts that differ from paintings, sculptures, mask, and clothing.

Introduction: Dear Current and Future Families, I hope this message finds you well. As the proud principal of Crown, I am honored to welcome all of you– our current families who continue to inspire us and the new families preparing to join our school community. At Crown, we believe education is a partnership between the school and families. Together, we create an environment where every child feels supported, valued, and encouraged to reach their fullest potential. For our current families, thank you for your ongoing trust and collaboration. Your involvement in your child’s education makes a significant impact, and we appreciate your commitment to their success. To our future families, we are excited to welcome you into our vibrant learning community. We look forward to working closely with you to ensure a smooth transition and a positive experience for your child. As we move forward, our focus remains on fostering curiosity, resilience, and kindness in every student. Our teachers and staff are here to support you and your children every step of the way. Our school team will be working hard to continue to provide high quality instruction to your scholars! It is our goal for all students to be on track for high school and beyond! Below are some of the programs we offer at Crown! Athletics We offer ample opportunities to participate in athletics. To complement our physical education program, we offer basketball, track and flag football, and volleyball! Music The music program offers students a well-rounded introduction to the world of music, focusing on performance, composition, listening, and contextualization. Students explore these key elements through fun and interactive activities. Drama The drama program offers a dynamic and engaging learning experience for students from kindergarten through middle school. In the primary grades, students dive into the world of storytelling. In the intermediate grades, students begin to explore acting through fun and interactive games, work on readers' theater scripts, and experiment with various acting techniques. By the time students reach middle school, they delve deeper into the world of theater by reading plays, writing their own scripts, and preparing scenes for performance. We are excited about all of our programs at Crown. If you have any questions, please feel free to call the school between the hours of 8:00am and 2:45pm and we will gladly assist you!

Introduction:
Dawes School is a Fine and Performing Arts Magnet Cluster Neigborhood School. Dawes School is committed to nurturing the unique talents and creative potential of every student. At Dawes, we believe in the transformative power of arts education and the ability it has to enrich all areas of learning. Our mission is clear: we work together to bring arts education to life through innovative, hands-on lessons that seamlessly integrate the arts across all subjects. 

Dawes School is  dedicated to providing rigorous instruction aligned to the standards through the implementation of a high quality curriculum that encourages students to express themselves fearlessly, explore new ideas, and cultivate a deep curiosity for learning. 

Through a blend of creative expression and social collaboration, we aim to foster lifelong learners who are compassionate, confident, and well-prepared for the future. At Dawes, we understand that every child is unique, and we strive to empower them to discover their own voice and make a positive impact in their communities.

Introduction:
Located in East Lakeview, Nettelhorst School is a Chicago Public School (CPS) Fine and Performing Arts magnet cluster school. We strongly emphasize an enhanced, interdisciplinary curriculum that cultivates independence, self-discipline, and a disposition for lifelong learning. We recognize that each child is unique and tailor instruction to meet individual needs.

 

Building a community is important to us. We stand firmly behind our school expectations:
  • Take care of yourself
  • Take care of others
  • Take care of our environment.
Through these expectations, we build moral character and a sense of community that begins in the classroom, weaves throughout the school, and extends beyond our building walls. Nettelhorst School values the partnership between home and school and encourages parents to participate in all aspects of their child's education—from preschool through the eighth grade.

 

Our school is a snapshot of this country in a building of over 600 students. Each day, we are tasked with creating an inclusive environment that celebrates and honors all of these differences. Our mission is to educate, support, and prepare our students for success.

Introduction: Nixon is a proud neighborhood school situated in the heart of the Hermosa community. We offer a rigorous curriculum focused on supporting students in engaging in complex tasks, making their thinking visible, and synthesizing learning through writing. We are a proud bilingual school with a Dual Language program beginning in Pre-K. Our goal is to promote a bilingual and bicultural environment that affirms all cultural and linguistic backgrounds. We aim to expose our students to varied enrichment opportunities, including, but not limited to: sports, fine arts, dance, and music . We pursue these goals through multiple and varied partnerships, including partnership with parents, elected officials, and community organizations, such as Family Focus, Hermosa Neighborhood Association, and many more. Visit our site or our school to learn more!

Introduction:
Ogden International is the only full continuum preK-12 public International Baccalaureate school in the State of Illinois, and only one of 25 in North America. Ogden is also one of the ten most diverse schools in the Chicago Public School District, serving the downtown area with families from foreign consulates and global corporations choosing to enroll at Ogden.

An Ogden International School education engages a K-12 diverse student body with inquiry-based learning experiences fostering empathy, critical thinking and global mindedness for the world of tomorrow. Ogden International’s globally-recognized IB programmes provide concept-based, academic frameworks, and student centered learning by inquiry grounded in global context and real life situations.

Ogden International provides a world-class education to students who will become leaders of change within the global community in the 21st century and beyond. Ogden International is committed to providing a distinctive, high-quality international education which cultivates intellectual inquiry and global engagement.

Introduction:
Oglesby provides quality education for all students. Each day students are challenged with rigorous learning in Math, Reading, Social Science and Science. We service students in a nurturing and safe environment. We have a variety of programs for students to patriciate in beyond the classroom including: Golf, Marital Arts, Band, STEM Programs, Visual Arts, Music, Cheerleading and all sports.

When you walk into the building I want you to feel safe and welcomed. It is our job to provide students with the best learning opportunities daily!

Our Theme this year is "It's A New Day At Oglesby!" We are dedicated to ensuring the best educational experience for you and your child. We look forward to having you as a partner in your child's educational journey.

“Oglesby School is dedicated to delivering a high-quality education to every student. We are committed to ensuring access to learning opportunities, fostering social-emotional learning (SEL), and maintaining a safe and supportive environment. Our goal is to empower each student to achieve their fullest potential in an inclusive and nurturing setting.” 

We believe wholeheartedly that every student deserves a quality education and that only happens when the school and the families work together for the best interests of our children. .

Introduction:
Welcome to James Otis Elementary School, a place where we strive to foster a supportive and engaging learning environment for all students. At Otis, we believe in nurturing curiosity and academic excellence by offering a wide range of educational opportunities. Our dedicated teachers and staff are committed to helping students develop the skills and confidence they need to succeed, both inside and outside the classroom. With a focus on community and collaboration, we aim to empower every child to reach their full potential and become lifelong learners.

At James Otis Elementary, we take pride in our strong sense of community and our commitment to creating a safe and inclusive space for every student. A key part of our approach is Personalized Learning, where we tailor educational experiences to meet the individual needs and interests of each student. By recognizing and valuing the unique strengths of every child, we ensure that every student has the opportunity to learn at their own pace and in ways that resonate with them. Through partnerships between families, staff, and the broader community, we work together to help our students thrive and develop essential skills for future success.

Introduction:
McPherson IB World School is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) school serving students in PreK to Grade 8. We are the neighborhood public school for students and families living in the Ravenswood and Lincoln Square communities of Chicago. Attendance boundaries for our school are determined by Chicago Board of Education.
 
Our school also serves students, regardless of attendance boundary, who are accepted into our specialized academic programs, which include: Early Childhood, Regional Gifted Center, Low-Incidence Cluster, and Multi-Sensory Cluster.
 
McPherson IB World School is dedicated to cultivating a vibrant community rooted in global citizenship and academic excellence. We prioritize the social-emotional needs of international-minded learners through an inquiry-based process that encourages success for all. Aligned with the Chicago Public Schools' mission, we are committed to providing a high-quality public education that prepares every child for success in college, career, and civic life, regardless of their neighborhood. As an International Baccalaureate (IB) school, we embrace the IB mission to develop inquiring, knowledgeable, and caring young people fostering intercultural understanding and respect. Together, we nurture a community of active, compassionate, and lifelong learners who celebrate diversity and contribute to a better and more peaceful world.

Introduction:
Logan Square Elementary School is a vibrant community school located in the Logan Square neighborhood. As one of the largest and oldest schools in the area, we have amazing facilities for our students. We have large classrooms, two gymnasiums, a new turf and playground, and an auditorium with updated lighting and sound features.

Our K-8 teachers have received training on personalized learning and differentiation to address individual student needs in reading, math, social studies, and science. Logan Square prioritizes a holistic view and has time dedicated to daily Social Emotional Learning and weekly lessons using the Second Step curriculum. Our successful Positive Behavioral Interventions and Supports (PBIS) system includes a school store where students spend their earned ‘sky bucks’.

Logan Square has many partnerships with organizations like Beverly Arts Center, Metropolitan Family Services, Communities in Schools, Ballet Folklorico de Chicago, and the Puerto Rican Arts Alliance, which bring programs like Spanish Guitar and Cuatro. We offer many after-school programs at no cost to families, including a chess team - which has competed in the national competition in Washington D.C.! Logan Square also has a long-standing relationship with the Palenque Logan Square Neighborhood Association and the Parent Mentors program.

As a community, we strive to become a more equitable, diverse, and inclusive school community. Visit us to learn more.

We are proud to offer a robust PK program in all five of our PK sections. To apply to our PK program, visit chicagoearlylearning.org. PK hours are 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Our K-8 student enrollment is based on attendance boundaries, but families can apply to the Magnet Cluster-World Language program if they are outside school boundaries.

Introduction:
“We make learning personal!”

School Vision    At Mt Vernon Elementary School our vision is to equip every student with the skills necessary to be critical thinkers, advocates of change, and innovative leaders throughout higher education, career, &  civic life.

School Mission  We provide an equitable and learner-driven approach where each student  identifies a pathway to success by engaging in rigorous instruction coupled with socio-emotional skill development and meaningful leadership opportunities that prepares them for civic and community engagement.

                                                           What is Personalized Learning?

Personalized Learning is a learner-driven instructional model that fosters 21st century skills by empowering every student to actively co-design their learning path, pace, and environment according to their individual needs, strengths, and interests.Personalized Learning Components

Learner Agency:   At Mount Vernon,  students actively engage in the learning process through deep reflection on their interests, strengths, work habits, needs, and goals.

Social Emotional Learning:   At Mount Vernon, we seamlessly integrate SEL practices into our classrooms. Through targeted SEL time, students develop the skills to guide their learning through personalized needs assessments.

Tailored Learning:  At Mount Vernon, we create personalized pathways for students to achieve their unique goals.

Authentic Learning:  At Mount Vernon, we create learning experiences that build on school-community relationships using authentic learning beyond the classroom.

Introduction: At Horace Mann, we believe in fostering a love of learning that extends beyond the classroom. Our dedicated team of educators is committed to providing dynamic, high-quality instruction tailored to meet the unique strengths of every student. We emphasize academic excellence through collaborative learning opportunities and rigorous tasks that foster teamwork, critical thinking, and innovative problem-solving in the core content areas: reading, math, science, and social science. In addition to these foundational subjects, we focus on character development and creativity to help students grow as capable, thoughtful individuals who are encouraged to think outside the box. We embrace a whole-child approach to education, nurturing not only intellectual growth but also social, emotional, and physical well-being. Our enriching extracurricular programs, including a vibrant marching band, dance, sports teams, and arts programs, provide students with opportunities to discover their passions, develop leadership skills, and cultivate meaningful connections through collaboration. By fostering these abilities, we empower students to grow as independent thinkers, compassionate leaders, and respectful, productive contributors to their community and society.

Introduction:
As one of 20 Sustainable Community Schools, we are proud to serve as a hub for holistic education and community engagement. At Yates, we are deeply committed to nurturing the unique potential of every child by fostering academic excellence, creativity, and social-emotional growth.

Our school is a place where the arts thrive, and we are thrilled to offer dynamic programs in Drama, Visual Arts, and STEM Design. These opportunities encourage our students to express themselves, think critically, and explore innovative solutions to real-world challenges. We believe that integrating the arts and STEM creates a well-rounded foundation that prepares our students for success in an ever-evolving world.

Collaboration is at the heart of what makes Yates special. Together with our students, families, and community partners, we work to create a safe, inclusive, and vibrant learning environment where every child feels empowered to excel and contribute.

We Love our Richard Yates Elementary family. We are excited to continue building a brighter future—together!

Introduction: Wadsworth STEM is a PreK-8 STEM school dedicated to fostering innovation and excellence. Our theme, “Believing Excellence is Attainable, We Are Developing Tomorrow’s Innovators,” reflects our commitment to empowering students for future success. Recognized by the State of Illinois for school improvement and achieving a prestigious Level 1+ School rating, we prioritize Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) as essential to our students' academic growth. Classrooms are equipped with multiple student computers, and we boast state-of-the-art Apple and PC computer labs. These labs focus on enhancing Math and Reading skills through programs such as I-Ready Math, Khan Academy, I-Ready Reading, and Accelerated Reader. Additionally, our STEM Innovation Lab and dynamic Media Lab provide students access to cutting-edge multimedia and engineering software, encouraging them to think critically and design future prototypes. Our new Makerspace offers a collaborative, creative environment where students engage in hands-on STEM projects and activities. Every K-8 student is equipped with an iPad, Chromebook, or laptop during instructional time, and all classrooms feature smart boards or interactive monitors to create an engaging, hands-on learning experience. These technologies empower students to explore concepts in innovative ways, ensuring they are prepared to excel in an ever-evolving world.

This means focusing not only on academic success but also on students' growth and well-being. We are working hard to fully implement our new approach by Fall 2025. This will be done in stages to give our schools and stakeholders time to understand changes and receive ongoing support. For more information, visit cps.edu/CIDT.
OverallRatingDescription: Per Chicago Board of Education policy, district-managed schools are assigned an annual school accountability status in order to identify schools on remediation or probation.
ClassificationDescription: Schools that have an attendance boundary. Generally, all students who live within this area may attend the school. Acceptance based on student living in boundary area or application if out of boundary area.
StudentGrowthDescription: Student Growth measures the change in standardized test scores between two points in time. This growth is compared to the average national growth for schools that started in the same place. A 50th percentile score means the school grew at the same rate as the national average.
PrekSchoolSummary: Our preschool program boosts academic skills through a play-based and inquiry-based approach which helps foster independence, prepares students for kindergarten, and instills a lifelong love of learning. Teachers utilize a district-wide curriculum, the Creative Curriculum, to provide support for student learning and development across all essential areas including social emotional skills. To ensure all students have the opportunity to engage in high-quality early learning experiences, preschool programs are offered free of charge.

Introduction:
Volta Elementary School is a vibrant learning community dedicated to academic excellence, inclusivity, and fostering a lifelong love of learning. A cornerstone of Volta’s commitment to inclusivity and academic rigor is our thriving Dual Language Program. Designed to promote bilingualism, biliteracy, and cross-cultural understanding. Our Dual Language Program provides students with the invaluable opportunity to learn in both English and Spanish. The Dual Language Program is a source of pride for our school community, embodying our belief in the power of language to connect and empower the next generation of future leaders. 

Located in the heart of Albany Park, one of the most diverse neighborhoods in Chicago, Volta serves a diverse population of students from Pre-K through 8th grade, embracing the cultural richness and unique talents that each child brings to our classrooms. Our school is committed to providing a well-rounded education through rigorous academics, engaging extracurricular programs, and a strong focus on social-emotional growth. At Volta, we strive to create a supportive environment where students, families, and staff collaborate to help every learner achieve their full potential and prepare for success in high school and beyond.

Introduction:
It is with great pride and deep gratitude to introduce myself as the principal of Taylor Elementary School. I am a proud life-long East Side resident, and I am honored to be given the opportunity to lead in the same school that invested in me as a young boy. I am a proud Taylor Elementary alumni, excited to collaborate with all parents, staff, and students to enrich, empower, and invest in our community together.

Throughout my career, I’ve held various roles within elementary and high schools - 7th/8th grade Math Teacher, Dean of Students, Cultural and Climate Coordinator, and Assistant Principal. In each of these roles, I have worked relentlessly to ensure that all students receive an educational experience that promotes academic achievement and character development. My experiences have shaped me into a leader of integrity, collaboration, and self-reflection for continuous learning and improvement. I am highly organized, self-starting, and committed to engaging all stakeholders to create powerful professional learning systems that guarantee exceptional teaching and learning for all students.

My commitment as the principal is to provide the highest quality of education possible in an engaging, safe, and positive learning environment for all students. Working collaboratively as a team with the school's hardworking staff and families, I commit to helping each student reach their fullest potential. I will work to ensure that all students, no matter their race, gender, abilities, socioeconomic status, or cultural background, have their perspectives heard and valued in order to provide equal access to all opportunities.

It is my goal to give the entire Taylor Elementary School community my very best and to serve them as a neighbor and a leader.

This means focusing not only on academic success but also on students' growth and well-being. We are working hard to fully implement our new approach by Fall 2025. This will be done in stages to give our schools and stakeholders time to understand changes and receive ongoing support. For more information, visit cps.edu/CIDT.

To ensure all students have the opportunity to engage in high-quality early learning experiences, preschool programs are offered free of charge.

Introduction:
As a Community of Learners, we pride ourselves in serving the whole child.  To ensure that students are thriving, we not only focus on the academic, but also the social emotional learning of all students so once they leave elementary school they are well prepared to take on their next steps into high school and ultimately, find success in their post-secondary choices.  We teach our students the importance of caring, Smyser CARES For Self, For Others, and For Our School.  We are here to make a difference in all of our students' lives by encouraging, educating, and believing in them.

Mission
Smyser Cares about meeting the needs of ALL learners. We prioritize the whole child, which includes student health and social-emotional wellbeing. Smyser engages and empowers students through a profound foundation of literacy, mathematics, and the sciences, while also integrating technology and fostering an appreciation for the arts. We are a safe and equitable environment where all students of diverse backgrounds feel welcome and are able to reach their highest potential to become productive citizens beyond Smyser Elementary School.

Vision 
 We, the community of Smyser Elementary School, believe that all children are entitled to an outstanding education, rich in opportunities and rewarding experiences. We are committed to providing a joyful, child-centered environment, a love of learning, pride in the Smyser School Community, and rigorous preparation for the demands of the 21st Century. Through this commitment, Smyser students will become successful individuals in a multicultural, complex, and changing world.

Introduction:
It is my pleasure to welcome you to our vibrant school community. At Prussing, we celebrate daily our proud tradition of academic excellence —including our renowned Comprehensive Gifted Program and Spanish World Language courses—while looking ahead to a dynamic future.

We are a school that believes in developing the whole child. Our mission is to cultivate a peaceful, inclusive community where every student is empowered to grow intellectually, socially, and emotionally.

You will see this mission in action every day. It's in the calm, safe, and orderly environment our community fosters. It's in our school-wide "PAWS" values—Peaceful, Accountable, Workwise, and Safe —which we celebrate with monthly SEL themes and "buddy activities" across grade levels. And it’s in our rigorous, modern curriculum and instruction, which we analyze with data to ensure every child is challenged and supported.

Our vision is to develop graduates who are curious, compassionate, and courageous thinkers , ready to meet any challenge and make a meaningful impact on their world.

We are not just a school; we are a community. Introduction:
Welcome to William H. Ray Elementary School, Home of the Ray Warriors!
As the committed principal of Ray and a long-standing member of this vibrant community, I am dedicated to serving our students, families, and staff. Together, we will continue to build a school where excellence, equity, and belonging guide every aspect of our work.
Since joining Ray, my goal has been to cultivate a cohesive and joyful learning community founded on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Each day, I am inspired by the curiosity of our students, the dedication of our educators, and the strong partnership we share with our families. Together, we are shaping a culture where every Ray Warrior is empowered to learn, lead, and thrive.
Our Core Values
Relationships First: Trust and care are the foundation of our community.
Excellence Through Inquiry: We learn, reflect, and improve together.
Equity in Action: Every decision centers on fairness, access, and opportunity.
At Ray, we are committed to joyful learning. We celebrate curiosity, creativity, and collective success, making every learning experience a joyful one.
Welcome to Ray—where learning is active, relationships matter, and every child’s brilliance is celebrated.

Ray School Vision
Every Ray School student will be provided a comprehensive elementary school experience that will equip them academically and socially to excel in high school, college, and life.

Introduction:
Rogers Fine Arts School endeavors to meet the academic, social and emotional needs of every student by implementing culturally responsive, arts-integrated curricula that celebrates creativity and differentiates instruction for all students in an inclusive learning environment. Our students can reach their highest potential through individual contribution and collaborative group efforts. Parents, teachers, students, community members and alumni working together will make the difference to help guarantee success for the Rogers Fine Arts School family.

The vision of Rogers Fine Arts School is to instill in our students a life-long appreciation for the Arts. Rogers strives to help students reach their highest potential through schoolwide creative and imaginative learning that values individual self-expression and the diversity of our school community.

Rogers is an ethnically, culturally, and economically diverse neighborhood school currently serving over 700 pre-kindergarten through 8th grade students. Our goal is to provide students with an environment that will allow all of them to reach their maximum potential, to learn to think critically, and to find joy in learning. Our auxiliary classes include physical education, performing and fine arts, technology, and library. We develop kind, empathetic learners and leaders. Our students regularly meet and exceed standards and many receive entry into selective enrollment high schools.

Introduction:
STOCK early childhood center, where all children belong.  We foster a love for learning in every child by providing inclusive and differentiated programs that nurture and support all of our students. The curricula is intentionally focused on developmentally appropriate social/emotional growth, self-help skills, challenging early learning provocations, fine arts and physical development. STOCK provides experiences and interactions that promote problem-solving and strategic reasoning skills, insightfulness, perseverance, curiosity and creativity. We have so much fun playing and learning at STOCK! 
STOCK uses a play-based team teaching approach to maximize the potential of our students. Every team consist of teachers and specialists, each with their own area of expertise, that collaborate and meet regularly to prioritize objectives, share information, and evaluate student progress. Parents and families are a central part of the school community, and STOCK believes that engaging parents in student learning is vital to student success.
STOCK school embraces a school climate that is warm, loving, stimulating, positive and productive. STOCK feels each student will reach their potential if they love school and love their teacher!

Introduction:
Welcome to Seward Academy

At Seward Academy, we take pride in offering a well-rounded educational experience that nurtures every learner from Pre-K through 8th grade. Our demographics include General Education, Diverse Learners, and Bilingual Education scholars, all supported through inclusive practices and high expectations for success.

As an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) Middle Years Programme (MYP) school serving 6th–8th grade, we empower students to think critically, act responsibly, and engage as global citizens. We also provide a strong Bilingual Education Program, ensuring our multilingual learners thrive both academically and linguistically.

Our Early Childhood Program lays the foundation for curiosity and lifelong learning, while our Out of School Time (OST) Program offers engaging opportunities in academics, arts, and enrichment beyond the school day.

At Seward, we celebrate every story—and empower every student to shine.
Bienvenidos a la Academia Seward

En la Academia Seward, nos enorgullece ofrecer una experiencia educativa integral que fomenta el crecimiento de cada estudiante desde Preescolar hasta 8.º grado. Nuestra comunidad incluye estudiantes de Educación General, Educación Bilingüe y Aprendices Diversos, todos apoyados mediante prácticas inclusivas y altas expectativas de éxito.

Como una escuela autorizada del Programa de los Años Intermedios (PAI) del Bachillerato Internacional (IB) que atiende a estudiantes de 6.º a 8.º grado, empoderamos a nuestros alumnos para que piensen de manera crítica, actúen con responsabilidad y se involucren como ciudadanos globales. También contamos con un sólido Programa de Educación Bilingüe, que garantiza que nuestros estudiantes multilingües prosperen tanto académica como lingüísticamente.

Nuestro Programa de Primera Infancia establece las bases para la curiosidad y el aprendizaje permanente, mientras que nuestro Programa de Extensión Escolar (OST) ofrece oportunidades enriquecedoras en lo académico, las artes y otras áreas de interés más allá del horario escolar.

En Seward, celebramos cada historia y alentamos a cada estudiante a brillar.

Introduction:
At Sherman School of Excellence, we strive to provide a safe, supportive, and inclusive learning
environment that promotes academic excellence through personalized and social-emotional
learning. We value collaboration with parents and community partners to create a strong sense
of community and family engagement by offering programs and opportunities to all stakeholders
before, during and after-school hours. Our personalized learning model puts students at the
center of their education in which they thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. This
student-centered approach cultivates a lifelong love of learning, builds essential skills like critical
thinking and problem-solving, and empowers students to navigate the complexities of the real
world. Explore our school website to learn more!

Introduction:
Scott Joplin Elementary School is a place where excellence, growth, and collaboration thrive. At Joplin, we are committed to providing a nurturing and inclusive environment that empowers every student to achieve their fullest potential.
Our school is deeply rooted in a tradition of academic achievement, creativity, and innovation, inspired by the legacy of our namesake, Scott Joplin, a pioneer of artistic excellence. We embrace this legacy by fostering a love for learning, critical thinking, and self-expression among our students.
Joplin places an emphasis on writing across content areas, vocabulary development and integration of technology in instructional practices. Joplin strives to create opportunities for educational empowerment while preparing students for college and career readiness.
The success of our school is a true testament to the strength of our community. Together, our dedicated educators, engaged parents, and supportive partners work as a team to ensure that our students receive the best possible education and opportunities to thrive. Scott Joplin is a GREAT place to learn, work, and grow.

SchoolLongName: William H Brown STEM Magnet Elementary School
Introduction:
At WHBrown STEM Magnet, our mission is to prepare our students for personal and academic success by providing a rigorous STEM integrated curriculum, which develops the whole child through the development of  creativity, collaboration, communication and critical thinking skills.

The vision of William H. Brown STEM Magnet School is to inspire and motivate our students to have self-awareness and a belief in their intellect, gifts and talents to become great problem solvers, collaborators, and communicators in a global environment. 

We are home to a full Broadcast studio to expose our students to journalism, video recording, and broadcasting. We have 1-to-1 technology for every student and 3 computer labs to increase the technological skills of our students and enhance the classroom learning experiences. 

Families who apply for a seat at WHBrown STEM Magnet through GoCPS will be eligible for transportation services if they reside between 1.5 miles and 6.0 miles from the school.

Introduction:
Our mission is to create a positive, supportive community of learners who work together to become our best selves.  We endeavor to cultivate a critical understanding of our community, and our world, so that we develop the necessary knowledge and skill to impact our future.  We value the uniqueness of each member of the Burke community and develop leaders who are ready to enter and transform our world.

Burke is a place where students develop a positive sense of self and others.  Students are empowered to collaborate, own their learning, and persevere in the face of both academic and social adversity.  They are supported and inspired by compassionate, committed adults who model the habits of collaboration, perseverance, reflection and refinement to provide a rigorous and critical curriculum to continuously improve our practice.  We acknowledge that our school’s, students’ and community’s success depends on a thoughtful partnership between each--a partnership that centers around social justice values and the best interest of our students as the driving force for our work together.

Introduction:
Jane Addams is a Personalized Learning School.  As a Personalized learning school, we utilize a learner-driven instructional model that fosters 21st century skills by empowering every student to actively co-design their learning path, pace, and environment according to their individual needs, strengths and interests, including a modified Comprehensive Gifted Program.  Jane Addams provides a rigorous academic approach that is student-centered, data driven, and promotes a positive learning environment for students, teachers, and the community.  We provide students access to extracurricular opportunities such as STEM, sports, music, academic support, student mentoring, and an engaging after school OST Program. We value building parent involvement through our BAC, PAC and PTO committees to empower families with the knowledge and resources to be successful. We have partnerships with the Museum of Science and Industry, Algebra Hub with Virtual Academy, Tutor Corp, Donors Choose, Project Syncere and ENpowered Games as well as Teach Plus.

Introduction:
At Tubman Elementary, we believe every student deserves a safe, supportive, rigorous, and equitable educational experience. We are proud to be both a Fine and Performing Arts Magnet Cluster School and an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) World School, offering our students the opportunity to think deeply, create freely, and act globally.

Whether your child is beginning their first school experience in Pre-K or preparing for high school in our middle grades, Tubman is a place where every learner is known, valued, and encouraged to reach their fullest potential.

We are proud of our academic growth — including a 20% increase in literacy proficiency over the past year — and continue to focus on accelerating outcomes for all learners. Our curriculum includes Skyline, Envision Math, Amplify Science, and Into Reading.

For students ready for more, we offer advanced math pathways, including compacted courses in middle school that prepare students for high school-level content. Our teachers meet regularly to analyze data, personalize instruction, and provide targeted interventions and enrichment to meet each child’s needs.

Tubman offers the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP), which nurture globally minded learners through inquiry-based instruction. Students explore big ideas, develop research and communication skills, and reflect on their role in the world. The IB curriculum helps students make connections between local and global issues, ask meaningful questions, and build intercultural understanding.

Our dedicated educators bring talent, expertise, and heart to their work every day. From classroom teachers and paraprofessionals to specials instructors and support staff, every adult at Tubman is committed to our students' success and well-being.

Equally important is our partnership with families. We engage parents through communication, events, and leadership opportunities, including the Local School Council and Friends of Tubman.

We also offer enrichment opportunities like after-school clubs, competitive sports, student council, field trips, and family nights.

Families choose Tubman because of our:

- Vibrant Fine and Performing Arts integration
- Rigorous, inquiry-based IB instruction
- Strong academic growth and personalized support
- Emphasis on whole-child development
- Inclusive, welcoming school culture
- Dedicated and passionate staff
- Strong family and community partnerships

Introduction:
George B. Armstrong School of International Studies is a proud neighborhood school dedicated to connecting academic programs with our students cultural heritages. We offer state-of-the-art facilities for science and art, as well as internet access in both the computer lab and every classroom. Our key partners, including S&C Electric Co.,  Junior Achievement, and Agents of Hope enhance our mission to provide a world-class education.

At Armstrong, we believe in the power of partnership between three essential pillars of a successful education: students, parents, and school staff. Together, we share a collective responsibility to empower our youth to achieve their highest potential.

Parents commit to ensuring their children arrive at school daily, ready to learn and in peak mental and physical condition.
Students commit to dedicating their full effort to the learning process, seeking academic and extracurricular opportunities, and prioritizing their education above all else.

Armstrong staffcommits to maintaining a safe, well-managed institution staffed with highly skilled, compassionate, and motivated professionals, offering a broad range of educational opportunities tailored to student growth.

Our students have boundless potential, and by working together, we can help them seize opportunities that align with their dreams, talents, and ambitions. With clear expectations and a shared commitment to excellence, we can build a vibrant community of lifelong learners. The best is yet to come as we work together to prepare our students for the bright futures that await their creativity, innovation, and leadership.
Together, we are "Building Champion Tigers."
Our core values guide this mission:

Try your best
Integrity
Global learners
Exceed expectations
Respect yourself and others
Socially responsible

Thank you for your dedication, collaboration, and passion in making George B. Armstrong School of International Studies an exemplar institution for learning. Let's continue to inspire our students to dream big, achieve more, and lead with purpose.

Introduction:
Esmond School serves students in Pre-Kindergarten through Grade 8, providing a rigorous and supportive educational environment grounded in research-based instructional practices. The school is committed to fostering academic excellence, critical thinking, and social-emotional development for all learners.
Esmond offers a comprehensive curriculum aligned with state and national standards. For students in Grades 6–8, Esmond implements the International Baccalaureate Middle Years Programme (I.B.M.Y.P.) a globally recognized framework that emphasizes inquiry-based learning, intercultural understanding and the development of responsible global citizens.
In addition to the core academic program, Esmond provides a range of extended learning opportunities designed to strengthen student achievement in reading, mathematics and science. Through targeted after-school programs, students engage in activities that enhance critical thinking, collaboration and problem-solving skills; key components of college and career readiness.
Through the 21st Century Community Partnership, Esmond School further enriches the student experience by offering programs that support social growth and cultural awareness. These include hip hop dance, chess, African dance and drumming, cheerleading, hair braiding, jewelry making, culinary dining, multimedia and library enrichment. Our team also offers math and science clubs, martial arts, line dancing for adults on Saturday and a variety of athletic programs.

Introduction:
Josephine C. Locke Elementary School, located in Chicago's Montclare neighborhood, is a community-centered institution with a rich cultural heritage while offering both the PYP (Prek-5th) and MYP (6th-8th) International Baccalaureate Programs. Serving generations of families, the school’s demographics have remained stable, with 85% of students being Hispanic, 10% White, 3% Black, 1% Asian, and 1% of mixed race.
At Locke, an IB education nurtures global citizenship, respect for diversity, and personal growth through a curriculum that fosters inquiry, action, and reflection. Rigorous, conceptual units of study encourage students to explore meaningful questions, take action in their communities, and reflect on their learning. Our adoption of Skyline supports this end.
We celebrate students’ identities with culturally relevant content and events offering “mirrors and windows” into various perspectives. Each student’s unique needs are met through proactive, individualized supports.
Our bilingual and ESL programs support English language learners and provide pathways for Spanish language acquisition, enhancing intercultural communication.
Students also participate in the Student Advisory Committee, giving them a voice in school decisions. Weekly social-emotional curriculums, Second Step (K-5) and Success Bound (6-8), that build well-being and learner profile development
Our ROAAAR values—responsibility, open- mindedness, adaptability, accountability, agency, and respect—shape a positive school culture.
Families and the community actively participate in numerous cherished annual events, such as the Back to School Bash, Winter Wonderland, Humanities Fair, Science Fair, Art Fair, International Day, Literacy Night, and the End of Year Blast. Beyond these events, Locke offers diverse extracurricular opportunities, including athletic programs, band, music, National Junior Honor Society, Green Team, Art, Media News, Chess, and dance.
The school prioritizes recognizing and nurturing each student's unique talents and strengths. Through strong partnerships with the community and a passionate staff, Locke prepares students to succeed academically and grow as global citizens, ensuring they are educated for a better world.

Introduction:
Welcome to the 2026–2027 School Year!

Dear Curtis Community,

On behalf of the entire faculty and staff, it is my absolute privilege to welcome our returning families and new students to the 2026–2027 school year! We are thrilled to open our doors to another year filled with discovery, growth, and community.

At Curtis, we are committed to creating an inclusive, challenging, and supportive environment where every student has the tools and encouragement needed to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. Our dedicated educators have spent the summer preparing engaging curriculums and inspiring learning spaces designed to bring out the best in every child.
Our work together is guided by our core purpose:

Our Vision: George W. Curtis Elementary School’s vision is to empower students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset needed to excel in both their academic journey and future careers, ensuring their readiness for the challenges and opportunities of college and beyond.

Our Mission: George W. Curtis Elementary School is dedicated to providing high-quality instruction that is enriched with comprehensive social-emotional learning, fostering an inclusive environment that ensures equitable opportunities for all students. Through this holistic approach, we empower students to excel academically and personally, enabling them to achieve lasting success in their diverse endeavors.

Education is a partnership between the school, the home, and the community. We encourage parents and guardians to stay connected, participate in school events, and communicate regularly with teachers and staff. Together, we can ensure a successful and rewarding year for all our students.

Please explore our website for important resources, including the school calendar, bell schedules, supply lists, and staff directories.

Thank you for your continued support and commitment to our school community. Let’s make the 2026–2027 school year our best one yet!

Warm regards,
Ingrid E. Boyd, Principal

Introduction:
Welcome to Edward K. "Duke" Ellington: A Healing-Centered Community of Learning

At Edward K. "Duke" Ellington, we are dedicated to nurturing a thriving and striving community where every learner is empowered to reach their full potential. We believe in holistic education, prioritizing not only academic excellence but also emotional well-being, college readiness, and a rich array of enrichment programs encompassing the arts, STEM, sports, and International Baccalaureate.

Our Commitment:

Holistic Learning: We provide a culturally rich curriculum featuring complex texts and invigorating challenges, tailored to meet the evolving needs of our students.

Healing-Centered Environment: We foster inclusivity through restorative practices, strong partnerships, and active parent engagement, creating a safe and supportive space for all.

Empowerment: We nurture individual strengths, encourage initiative, and cultivate risk-takers who embrace diverse perspectives with kindness.

Accountability: We are self-reflective thinkers, committed to delivering on our promises and dedicated to achieving excellence.

Growth: We are inquirers who welcome challenges, pursue continuous learning, remain open-minded to new ideas, and embrace change for improvement.

Leadership: We are effective communicators who inspire the community through actions, cultivate leadership at all levels, maintain balance, and are knowledgeable in our endeavors.

Esteem: We are principled and develop a deep appreciation and respect for ourselves and others.

Service & Professionalism: We go above and beyond by serving and caring for the entire school community.

Our vision is to create a healing-centered community of learners who thrive and strive for excellence. We are committed to providing a transformative educational experience that empowers our students to become confident, compassionate, and successful individuals. Join us as we build a brighter future, together.

PrekSchoolSummary: Our Gold Circle of Quality Preschool Program at Edward K. "Duke" Ellington provides a nurturing and stimulating environment for our youngest learners. We offer a range of options, including a blended half-day program for three-year-olds, two blended full-day programs, and a general full-day program for four-year-olds. Introduction:
Welcome to Lawndale Community Academy where every student is seen, valued, and empowered to thrive. Located in the heart of the North Lawndale community on Chicago’s West Side, our school embraces the rich history and resilient spirit of this neighborhood while charting a bold path forward.  At Lawndale Community Academy, our vision is clear: to create a safe, positive, and supportive learning environment where all scholars are equipped to become college, career, and community-ready global thinkers. 

We offer strong Tier 1 instruction grounded in academic excellence, and we recognize that learning begins with relationships, trust, and empowerment. Our community partners collaborate with us to deliver enrichment, intentional support, and opportunities for all students and families. 

If you’re looking for a school where your child will be challenged, cared for, and prepared for tomorrow where high expectations meet unwavering belief then Lawndale is the place for you. I am honored to lead this community of educators, staff, families, and students. Together, we will continue to grow, support each other, and make our Panther pride shine.

Introduction: West Park STEAM Academy emphasizes science, technology, engineering, fine arts, and mathematics. Emphasizing and focusing on 21st century skills needed for each child to reach beyond and be empowered to be active participants in our global society. Creativity teaches students to think outside the box. Collaboration shows students how to work together to achieve a common goal. Communication lets students learn how to best convey their ideas and evaluate how others’ are interpreting them. We are creating an environment where teachers, students, and community members communicate, engage, create, imagine, collaborate, and build relationships together with purpose. Our students and our teachers are becoming innovators and shaping the future of what quality education looks like at Chicago Public Schools.

Introduction:
It's a wonderful day to soar high! Joseph Kellman Corporate Community School provides a rigorous, supportive, inclusive, and engaging learning environment for students in Pre-K through 8th grade. Under new leadership starting School Year 2026-2027, Kellman is strengthening teaching and learning through a distributed leadership model that includes a Lead Instructional Coach and three Teacher Leader Coaches. Our instructional practices prioritize building collective efficacy and collaborative teacher planning for improving student outcomes.

As a Technology Magnet Cluster School, Kellman integrates technology, digital learning, creativity, visual arts, and innovation across the student experience.

Kellman is proud to introduce a new Primary Cluster Program for students with disabilities, expanding our ability to provide specialized instruction and individualized support for our youngest learners.  

Kellman is also excited to offer a new integrated Library & Arts Program, where literacy and creativity come together. Students develop a love of reading, strengthen research and inquiry skills, and extend their learning through art and creative expression.  

Students also have access to Full-Day Pre-K and Kindergarten, Digital Media Arts, Yoga, Technology, Social-Emotional Learning (SEL),  after-school programming, and winning boys' and girls' sports programs. Students engage in a rigorous, standards-aligned curriculum designed to strengthen literacy, mathematics, critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, and digital citizenship.

Our high-quality curriculum includes Skyline for ELA, Social Studies, and Science and i-Ready for Mathematics. Kellman also provides targeted foundational literacy, MTSS Framework for interventions, and small-group academic support to meet the individual needs of students.

Through strong community partnerships, students and families receive additional academic, social-emotional, attendance, enrichment, and family support. Partners include Partners Integrating Education (P.I.E.), Illinois Action for Children (IAC), Juvenile Protective Association (JPA), and Chapter One.

Kellman is committed to developing the whole child by providing rigorous academics, inclusive learning opportunities, technology-rich instruction, creative and physical enrichment, social-emotional support, and opportunities for every student to discover their strengths and talents.

Introduction:
Carl Von Linne School is a neighborhood school with a proud tradition of serving the Avondale community for nearly 130 years. Through partnerships with esteemed organizations such as the Joffrey Ballet, The Chicago Jazz Philharmonic, Forward Momentum Chicago, and Communities in Schools, Linne provides a comprehensive and integrated Fine Arts program that enriches students' education. Students benefit from a full theater program beginning in third grade, as well as opportunities to participate in a rock band, concert band, guitar ensemble, and martial arts program.

Linne also offers an inquiry-based science curriculum supported by two dedicated science labs and state-of-the-art technology, including a Mac Lab, a 1:1 student-to-laptop ratio, iPads, and interactive panels in every classroom. Our optional Spanish Immersion Dual Language Program enables students to become biliterate, fostering skills that will serve them for a lifetime. Additionally, Linne offers High School Algebra for eligible 7th and 8th graders and High School Geometry for eligible 8th graders, providing advanced academic opportunities to prepare students for future success.

Facilities such as a full culinary arts kitchen, ceramics room and kiln, dance studio, and music room further support our mission of educating the whole child and ensuring that every student is given the tools to explore their passions and achieve their fullest potential. At Linne, we are committed to providing a well-rounded, innovative, and dynamic learning experience for all our students.

Introduction:
Theodore Herzl School of Excellence is located in North Lawndale whose core values are: We Are Scholars. We Are Leaders. We Respect Ourselves, Each Other, and Our Community.

Students and graduates of the Herzl School of Excellence will be scholars, leaders, problem-solvers, and compassionate productive members of our society through a shared, relentless focus on academic excellence and character. 

The Herzl Community commits to sustaining a culture of respect and achievement where learning is rigorous, excellence is the standard, talent is nurtured, success is celebrated, and character is molded and modeled through the principles of the Herzl Doctrine in a conducive, safe, learning environment.

Scholar Creed (Scholar Affirmation)®

I am a scholar and a leader.
I respect my classmates, my teachers, my community, and most of all, myself.
I believe in myself and my ability to learn. 
I have the power to overcome any obstacle that comes my way.
I exude excellence because I am smart, I am talented, and I will achieve.

Introduction:
Welcome to Hibbard Elementary, a vibrant, multilingual and multicultural school community where we believe that language, culture, and identity are strengths.

Hibbard is proud to offer a comprehensive two-way Spanish Dual Language Program from PreK through 6th grade, developing students who are bilingual, biliterate, and culturally responsive. Our General Education program provides equally rich and rigorous learning experiences while honoring the many languages, cultures, identities, and experiences our students bring to our school community.

At Hibbard, we believe students thrive when academic excellence is paired with belonging, creativity, wellness, and opportunity. Our partnerships with The People’s Music School and Tapestry 360 expand access to music education and health and wellness services. As a Communities In Schools partner school, we benefit from additional supports and resources that strengthen our students, families, and teachers and help our entire school community thrive. As an ASCA RAMP-designated school, we are also proud of our comprehensive school counseling program and commitment to supporting the whole child.

Beyond the school day, families have access to YMCA after-school care, providing students with a safe and enriching place to learn, play, and connect.

At Hibbard, every child brings something powerful to our community, and we are committed to ensuring every student is known, valued, challenged, and prepared to thrive.

Introduction: Holden is a diverse PK-8 school serving the Bridgeport neighborhood in Chicago. Our rigorous curriculum and well-rounded programs prepare students for success in college, career, and productive citizenship. Holden is recognized for its competitive math team, established art and music programs, and high rates of student acceptance to selective enrollment high schools.  Our teachers focus on students’ unique learning needs and create inclusive environments that demonstrate respect for diversity and build connections among students, staff, families, and the community. As a Fine Arts Magnet school, we integrate art, music, and creative expression across the curriculum.  Beyond core academics, we also offer a wide range of enrichment opportunities, including Math Team, high school credit courses (Algebra/ Geometry), intervention and after-school programs such as sports, STEM, rock band, drama, podcasting, and art club. Through high expectations and a focus on students’ future, we strive to instill productive work and character habits embodied in our school motto "Hard work, success, and nothing less!"

Introduction: I am delighted to extend a warm and enthusiastic welcome to all students, parents, and community members to the new academic year at John B. Drake Elementary School. As we embark on this educational journey together, I am excited to share our commitment to fostering excellence in education, equity, and a positive school environment. . Our continuous improvement efforts are centered around enhancing our curriculum and instruction practices. Our educators are committed to staying abreast of the latest pedagogical approaches and research-backed strategies. Doing so ensures that our students receive the most relevant, engaging, and effective educational experience possible. At Drake, we celebrate diversity and embrace the strength that comes from different perspectives and experiences. Creating an inclusive and supportive learning environment is paramount to us. We are fully dedicated to ensuring that every student feels valued, respected, and included. Drakes 3 Big Rocks are: Literacy- Provide High-quality Tier 1 instruction in all content areas; ensure that reading math, science, and social studies are aligned to the CSS; ensure that science is aligned to NGSS; and provide intervention/enrichment for all students according to their learning needs. Targeted Universalism- (TU) is an approach to equity work that recognizes groups of people have differing needs and require specific support to reach the same goal. Positive Culture and Climate- Establish a school-wide behavior management system and implement a positive system of support that focuses on the SEL needs of all students. As we embark on this academic year, I am grateful for your ongoing partnership in the education of our students. Your involvement, dedication, and support are invaluable to us, and together, we will continue to nurture a learning community where every individual can thrive. Please explore our website to learn more about our programs, events, and ways to get involved. I am excited for the journey ahead and look forward to a year filled with growth, achievement, and positive experiences for all.

Introduction:
THE FERNWOOD ELEMENTARY SCHOOL  
Promoting and supporting high achievement for all students is the primary mission of Fernwood Elementary School. To accomplish this mission, we believe that it is the responsibility of the school to provide a student-centered, comprehensive, safe and caring learning environment for all children. Moreover, the mission of Fernwood Elementary School includes the development of confident, competent children who are well-prepared for college and/or careers in a culturally diverse democratic society. 

What We Believe:

  - We believe strongly in achieving excellence and equity for every child. 

  - We believe that every child has talent and has something valuable to contribute to our society and to other people. 

  - We believe in our professional staff and expect them to be performance-oriented in helping students meet today's problems as well as the challenges of tomorrow. 

  - We believe that if this is accomplished, children will then come to realize more fully their own potential as individuals and are better prepared to appreciate and act responsible in the society in which they live.

Introduction:
Greetings All,

As the proud principal of Eugene Field, I am extremely honored to share important information that gives insight as to who we are as a school community.  Eugene Field’s mission is centered around providing a high quality, culturally responsive education to support our students in a 21st century society.  Our “North Star” of where we want to go, resides in our vision of “personalizing learning experiences for EVERY student to empower them to be successful” which aligns with our District’s vision, “Success Starts Here”.  To this point, I’ll provide a glimpse into our curriculum, programming and partnerships.  As we continue to evolve within CPS, it is our hope that we bring engaging programming and learning experiences that are equitable, rigorous and joyful for all of our students.
As we focus on providing equitable, rigorous learning experiences, we know this cannot be done without a high-quality curriculum. To this end, we have adopted the Skyline curriculum.  We utilize Skyline for ELA, Math, Science and Social Studies. We have three full time holistic teachers–P.E., Music, and Computer Science.  Due to the size of our school, these full-time teachers are also able to support our students in other content area classes as well as provide MTSS Tier I and Tier II support, where needed. Our classroom sizes are typically smaller than the average school (most classes have less than 25 students), with no class exceeding 30 students.   We expect students to experience high expectations for themselves and others when it comes to engaging in learning content. We expect students to experience both success and failure, as both are needed for growth.  We expect our instructional staff to differentiate learning to meet students where they are, yet progress students towards and beyond grade level proficiency. With the District continuing to provide equitable funding and resources for our students, full engagement and positive support from all stakeholders, our students will continue to thrive and make the world a better place.

Introduction:
Dear Fiske Community and Families,

Welcome to a vibrant new school year at Fiske Elementary IB World School! Whether you are returning to our hallways or stepping through our doors for the first time, we are thrilled to welcome your family to a community where young minds truly thrive.

At Fiske, we do more than just teach—we inspire. Guided by our International Baccalaureate (IB) Middle Years Programme, we empower students to become bold critical thinkers, lifelong learners, and compassionate global citizens who learn by doing. Every day, we bring the IB Learner Profiles to life, cultivating a culture grounded in positivity, self-motivation, and mutual respect. We nurture the whole child, ensuring every student grows socially, emotionally, and academically in a safe, dynamic environment.

We know it takes a village to raise tomorrow's leaders. When families and educators stand united, our students achieve extraordinary things. We warmly invite you to partner with us as active participants in your child’s educational journey, shaping a future filled with discovery, deep connection, and limitless success.

Let’s make this school year remarkable—together!

Principal Roan

Chicago Public Schools (CPS) is reimagining our approach to accountability, emphasizing the holistic development of students. This means focusing not only on academic success but also on students' growth and well-being. We are working hard to fully implement our new approach by Fall 2025. This will be done in stages to give our schools and stakeholders time to understand changes and receive ongoing support. For more information, visit cps.edu/CIDT.
OverallRatingDescription: Per Chicago Board of Education policy, district-managed schools are assigned an annual school accountability status in order to identify schools on remediation or probation.
ClassificationDescription: Schools that have an attendance boundary. Generally, all students who live within this area may attend the school. Acceptance based on student living in boundary area or application if out of boundary area.
ProgramsSummer: 1st Summer Literacy Camp Tatina, 1st Summer Literacy Camp Carroll, 1st Summer Literacy Camp Gerardi, 2nd Summer Literacy Camp, 3rd Summer Literacy Camp, Algebra Preparation I, Algebra Preparation II
StudentGrowthDescription: Student Growth measures the change in standardized test scores between two points in time. This growth is compared to the average national growth for schools that started in the same place. A 50th percentile score means the school grew at the same rate as the national average.
PrekSchoolSummary: Our preschool program boosts academic skills through a play-based and inquiry-based approach which helps foster independence, prepares students for kindergarten, and instills a lifelong love of learning. Teachers utilize a district-wide curriculum, the Creative Curriculum, to provide support for student learning and development across all essential areas including social emotional skills. To ensure all students have the opportunity to engage in high-quality early learning experiences, preschool programs are offered free of charge.

I am also proud to highlight the innovative teaching practices happening in our classrooms. Our educators are continually exploring new ways to engage students, integrate technology, and foster critical thinking. These approaches not only support academic growth but also prepare our students to be creative, confident problem-solvers in an ever-changing world. Programs.ProgramOverview:
Personalized learning is a learner-driven instructional model that fosters 21st century skills by empowering every student to actively co-design their learning path, pace, and environment according to their individual needs, strengths, and interests. Simply put, at the core of personalized learning is learner agency.

Technology Program schools thoughtfully integrate technology and digital media throughout the curriculum to ensure that students develop the skills and habits of mind that will enable them to be successful in whatever endeavors they wish to pursue. This includes enabling students to use technology and digital media to demonstrate creative thinking and construct knowledge; communicate and work collaboratively; gather, evaluate and use information; conduct research, manage projects, and solve problems; practice legal and ethical behaviors while online; and understand technology concepts, systems, and operations.

Introduction: Milton R. Brunson School is committed to nurturing the whole child by cultivating learners to become responsible advocates, autonomous decision-makers, and contributing global citizens that are agents of change. At Brunson, we believe in creating a stimulating environment that provides a rigorous and engaging curriculum tailored to meet individual learners’ academic instructional needs designed with their interests in mind. We are a Personalized Learning School. Our students are provided individualized learning plans where they are afforded opportunities to engage in academic learning experiences at their own pace, independently or in small groups. Teachers and students collaborate to co-design their learning paths through learner work menus and skill-focused instruction. In addition, we are a Mathematics and Science Magnet Cluster School, where we offer math, science, and technology as our core curriculum. Brunson is equipped with two science labs, a computer lab, and an art room. Brunson offers Out of School Time Programs, You Can Be A Chemist, Sports Programs, and Communities In School Partnerships.

Introduction:
At Daisy Bates Academy of Social Justice, we are committed to providing a rigorous, relevant, and socially-conscious education in a nurturing and inclusive environment. Our focus is on the relentless pursuit of academic excellence, fostering a community where high expectations are not just set but are consistently met.

We integrate arts, technology, and social justice principles to cultivate critical thinking, creativity, and empathy. Our diverse and dynamic community celebrates the unique strengths of each individual, while instilling in all of our students a deep sense of responsibility toward their peers and the world around them.

Through engaging curriculum and hands-on experiences, we encourage curiosity, inspire leadership, and prepare our students to become change-makers who will thrive both in school and beyond. At Daisy Bates Academy, we don’t just educate—we empower students to become agents of positive change in their communities and in the world

Introduction:
Little Village Elementary is a neighborhood school that welcomes and empowers all students to grow as global citizens. We address students’ social-emotional needs while providing a culturally responsive program that nurtures both academic and personal development. Our inclusive, safe, and student-centered environment values every voice and celebrates diversity.

Selected to offer a Dual Language program, Little Village Elementary promotes bilingualism, biliteracy, and cross-cultural understanding, preparing students to thrive in an interconnected world. As an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) World School for grades 6–8, we provide students with rigorous, inquiry-based learning experiences that foster critical thinking and global awareness. Designated as an Illinois Horizon School to Watch, Little Village Elementary is nationally recognized for its exemplary educational practices.
